roles.title: CEO

roles.title: Creative Director
roles.question: Is the creative direction clear, ownable, and non-template?

roles.question: Does every scene have its own composition, rhythm, mood, and visual center?

roles.question: Does type carry character and brand voice — not a default stack?

roles.question: Does color create the intended emotion — not decoration?

roles.question: Does every animation have meaning — or is it noise?
